baseDraft.subject: a fox in a yellow raincoat crossing a flooded street

scenarios.name: Grade morphing
scenarios.proves: One Intensity dial re-grades every equipped card's text
checks: Slide Intensity from Subtle to Extreme on the Illumination panel
The equipped cards' grade names change on their faces
The merged prompt line swaps in the louder fragments

scenarios.name: Tail toggle
scenarios.proves: The Midjourney tail joins the prompt only while enabled
checks: The merged prompt ends with --ar 16:9 --stylize 250
Toggle the Midjourney tail off on the Execution panel
The parameters leave the prompt; the descriptive line stays intact

scenarios.name: Affinity filter
scenarios.proves: Intensity-gated cards leave and rejoin the deck as the dial moves
checks: At Subtle the Tone deck hides Neon Saturation and Candy Pop
Slide Intensity to Bold and both return to the deck
The equipped Muted Palette card stays in its slot throughout

scenarios.name: Reference stack
scenarios.proves: References holds four stacked influences and caps there
checks: The References loadout reads 4/4
Clicking a fifth reference card does not equip it
All four reference fragments join the merged prompt in slot order

scenarios.name: Snap memory
scenarios.proves: Arrangements are remembered per Intensity configuration
checks: Slide Intensity to Subtle: Storm Light drops from its slot and a replacement is suggested
Slide back to Extreme: the original two-card arrangement returns from memory
Golden Hour never leaves its slot

scenarios.name: Comma hygiene
scenarios.proves: The merge collapses whitespace and never doubles commas

scenarios.name: Exclusion tail
scenarios.proves: The --no exclusion rides the tail and leaves with it
checks: The merged prompt ends with --no text, watermark

The exclusion field keeps its value for when the tail returns

scenarios.name: Full house
scenarios.proves: Every panel contributes one fragment in merge order
checks: The stepper shows all seven letters complete
The merged line runs subject, protagonist, canvas, universe, illumination, tone, references, execution
The tail closes the line with --ar 21:9 --stylize 200
